name: gtlayout.library
notes: Olaf Barthel’s optimized 47.1 binary matches the copy bundled with the pinned MagicMenu II archive. The current standalone Aminet archive has 47.2.

The installed MagicMenuPrefs 2.35 opens gtlayout.library v37 or later and keeps its own MagicMenu manifest, icon, profile and startup files. MiamiDx ships its own MUI modules and selector. There is no package-owned L: member.
